name: Measure-Theoretic Indicator Functions
description: Replaced the concept of isometries (which map intervals to intervals of identical length) with binary-valued indicator functions over $[0, T]$. The interval length constraint is enforced via definite integrals, and the disjointness/ordering constraints are enforced via integrals of products and pointwise bounds on the support. This preserves the exact mathematical sums but destroys text affordances related to "distance" or explicit "intervals", forcing genuine deduction.
